treasurySweep.howTo: HDFC NetBanking → Accounts → Current → Draw OD. Enter exact amount. Notify Sonal. Repay immediately when receivables clear.

receivablesReachable.bestFor: Fastest path to cash. Free. Chase before anything else.

odCapacity.bestFor: Bridge a gap when receivables won't clear in time. Revolving — repay when cash arrives.

treasuryLiquid.bestFor: Last resort. Breaking compounding costs more than interest saved.

vendorStretch.bestFor: Buy time without cash. Use sparingly — goodwill erosion compounds.
